mode.title: Mode
mode.description: markets = every live futures market with price, volume, open interest and funding. funding = the funding rate history for selected markets. positions = the open positions held by wallet addresses you supply. traders = recent large trades with the wallet addresses behind them, which is how you find accounts to look up.
enumTitles: Recent large trades and who made them

coins.title: Coins (optional)
coins.description: BTC, ETH, SOL and so on. Empty returns every live market in markets mode, and the five busiest in funding mode.

walletAddresses.title: Wallet addresses
walletAddresses.description: Positions mode. Positions on this exchange are public, so any address can be looked up.

hoursBack.title: Hours of funding history
hoursBack.description: Funding mode. Funding settles every hour here, so 24 gives 24 rows per market.

minDayVolumeUsd.title: Minimum 24h volume
minDayVolumeUsd.description: Markets mode. Skip markets trading less than this in the last 24 hours.

includeDelisted.title: Include delisted markets
includeDelisted.description: Off by default. Delisted markets remain in the exchange response carrying a stale price with no volume, which reads as a live market unless excluded.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned, busiest markets first. Controls total cost.

minTradeUsd.title: Minimum trade size
minTradeUsd.description: Traders mode. Only return trades worth at least this much, largest first. The exchange publishes only the latest handful of trades per market, so a high floor often returns nothing.
